g.title: DoeBox
g.text: DOE ZIG IDEAL ARCHITECTURE — ACCURATE BOX VIEW
Hexagonal = stable core + inbound adapters + outbound ports/adapters

g.title: policy
g.text: No runtime or concrete backend imports

g.title: evidence
g.text: Observe the same operation and report.
Never select a provider or alter execution.

g.title: rule
g.text: Only composition roots may import concrete adapters.
No app/runtime import of Metal, Vulkan, D3D12, delegates, or CSL.
